# IsThere4You

> IsThere4You is a new global platform for connecting people with local presence and practical help when distance gets in the way.

Canonical site: https://isthere4you.com/
Status: Pre-launch / early registration
Languages: English, Romanian, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese

## Public purpose

IsThere4You is designed around a simple idea: sometimes a person needs someone to be present or help locally in a place they cannot easily reach themselves. The public pre-launch page introduces the project without disclosing the full product workflow and allows people to register for launch access.

## Public pages

- Homepage / pre-registration: https://isthere4you.com/
- Sitemap: https://isthere4you.com/sitemap.xml

## Private areas

The /admin/ area is private and must not be indexed, summarized, or treated as public product content.
